recommendation: Keep this commit. It aligns the current core search parameter with FHIR-12866 while preserving later SDC ownership and recursive search behavior; any future changes to the isSubject extension definitions belong in the SDC IG rather than core.
issue_request: FHIR-12866 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 Questionnaire. It required removing QuestionnaireResponse.item.subject, adding boolean isSubject markers on Questionnaire.item and QuestionnaireResponse.item, allowing the Questionnaire.item marker only on reference questions, and defining a reference item-subject search parameter for QuestionnaireResponses by items with isSubject=true.
initial_application: The Jira application comment cites svn revision 13986, represented by git commit b6facb155a295bc977faa219f300c573aeb8034f. That commit disabled QuestionnaireResponse.item.subject in the QuestionnaireResponse spreadsheet and added isSubject rows to the then-current Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse extension spreadsheets before later source refactors replaced those spreadsheets.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse remain active in source/fhir.ini, and current QuestionnaireResponse source no longer has QuestionnaireResponse.item.subject. FHIR-19527 later moved questionnaire-isSubject and questionnaireresponse-isSubject to SDC; the combined branch already includes the FHIR-19527 reconciliation pointing item-subject at the SDC response extension URL. FHIR-31479 replaced an invalid hasExtension expression with extension(...).exists(), and FHIR-49784 made the item traversal recursive; those later decisions did not change the seed requirement that the boolean marker be true.
reconciliation: Changed source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml so QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject preserves the SDC canonical URL and recursive traversal but filters with extension('http://hl7.org/fhir/uv/sdc/StructureDefinition/sdc-questionnaireresponse-isSubject').value = true before returning Reference answers.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/bundle-QuestionnaireResponse-search-params.xml: QuestionnaireResponse-item-subject now tests the SDC questionnaireresponse-isSubject extension value for true instead of matching any extension occurrence.

related_jiras.note: Moved questionnaire-isSubject and questionnaireresponse-isSubject out of core to SDC; the reconciliation preserves that ownership and uses the SDC canonical response extension.

Corrected the item-subject expression from invalid hasExtension(...) to extension(...).exists(); this fix preserves valid FHIRPath while refining the predicate to the boolean true value requested by FHIR-12866.
Made QuestionnaireResponse item search expressions recursive; this fix preserves that traversal.
Earlier SDC no-change issue confirmed the use case for item-level subjects but did not require SDC support at that time.
